item.title: Private ICDs allowed to impose 20pc tariff hike at Ctg Port
item.description: CHATTOGRAM, Jan 7: The Bangladesh inland container depots (BICDA), the Association of private ICD and stakeholders, have agreed on a 20 percent increase in tariffs for export and empty container handling at the depots for a period of six months effective from January.The decision was taken in a meeting held recently with CPA Chairman Rear Admiral SM Moniruzzaman and the major stakeholders, including garment and knitwear exporters, to resolve the stalemate over tariff hikes by the private ICDs.IC

item.title: BD now in US visa bond scheme

item.description: The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) faces growing pressure from LPG traders, who have demanded fresh price adjustments within 24 hours and warned of a nationwide suspension of LPG supply and marketing starting Thursday.The ultimatum came from the LPG Traders Cooperative Society Limited during a human chain protest in front of the Jatiya Press Club on Wednesday. item.title: Trump invites Colombia president to White House after threats
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Wednesday invited his Colombian counterpart Gustavo Petro to the White House, just days after threatening him with military action over alleged drug trafficking.Trump had warned Petro on January 3 to "watch his ass" following US forces' ousting of leader Nicolas Maduro in neighboring Venezuela.On Wednesday, following the first phone call between the leaders since Trump took office in January, the 79-year-old Republican said he was arranging to meet with Petro "in the

item.title: Snow forces around 140 flight cancellations in Paris
item.description: Around 100 flights were cancelled at Paris's Charles de Gaulle airport on Wednesday morning because of snowfall and fierce cold, and a further 40 were cancelled at Orly airport, France's transport minister said.The flights disruptions had already been anticipated late Tuesday, and Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot told CNews television he was "hoping the situation returns to normal this afternoon".

item.title: Messi would prefer to be an owner rather than a coach when he quits playing

item.title: Young man dies 'while making bomb' inside house
item.description: A young man was killed after a crude bomb exploded while he was making it inside a house in Jajira upazila of Shariatpur district early Thursday.The incident happened around 4AM at Mulai Beparikandi area.Deceased Sohan Bepari, 32, was son of Delwar Bepari of the Cherag Ali Bepari Kandi area of the upazila.The house was also blown apart in the explosion.Quoting the local residence, police said, the explosion took place at around 4AM inside an abandoned room of a house owned by Nurul Islam Bepari
